export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, {reason}: {reason: string}): Promise<void> {
  void reason;
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

export async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], {reason}: {reason: string}): Promise<void> {
  void reason;
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}
